summary: In .github/workflows/envoy-and-contracts.yaml, replace the broad `envoy` gate of dispatch-memory, dispatch-multiprocess, broker-multiprocess, envoy-go-race and envoy-infra-go with one filter per job (dispatch_memory, dispatch_multiprocess, broker_multiprocess, envoy_go_race, envoy_infra_go), built from shared YAML anchors (bun_install, go_workspace, dispatch_server, listener_command, dispatch_command_tests) and identical to router PR #2316's filters except the workflow file name and without the four memory-profile guides CI never reads. `envoy` keeps its patterns and gates envoy-go alone. Add the five outputs, change the five if: lines, correct the false comments, add one sentence per guide naming each job's filter, prove AC2 with two scratch PRs based on legion/INFRA-583, and measure AC3 by replaying the INFRA-490 window's PR runs through the new filters.
tasks: 1. Fetch; before the final push diff main@origin against the fork point for packages/envoy, go.work*, packages/daemon/go.mod|sum, packages/contracts/fixtures, packages/proof-editor, package.json, bun.lock, patches, .github/actions; add any new closure package or file read (#2229 listenfd, #2167 cmd/listener race step and contracts/fixtures/dispatch-targeted-delivery.json) to every filter that compiles or reads it. Do not merge main without a real conflict.

2. Edit .github/workflows/envoy-and-contracts.yaml: shared groups and five filters (plan.md Appendix A) after bun_toolchain, with file:line comments ported from #2316 lines 101-306 and 624-705; five outputs in changes.outputs (127-138); if: lines 901, 957, 993, 1031, 1076; comment corrections at 49, 146-152, 182, 207-208, 209-211, 1103-1108, 1070-1072, and one clause per job header naming its filter. No on: edit (every new path is already under on.paths). No ! pattern; envoy_image untouched.

3. Throwaway checks: recompute closures (plan.md Appendix B) and run the coverage script against the edited workflow's filters with its negative control; check-image-trigger-paths.sh (+ .test.sh, needs PyYAML under $TMPDIR), check-action-pins.sh, check-private-names.sh, pinned actionlint. Restore packages/envoy/infra/go.work.sum after go list in infra (the pod's Go rewrites it).

4. Docs (AC4): no README describes these filters; correct the workflow comments and add one sentence naming the gating filter in packages/envoy/cmd/dispatch/AGENTS.md:570-590, packages/envoy/AGENTS.md:598-601 and 3843-3849, packages/envoy/infra/AGENTS.md:338-350.

5. Push, open the PR against main with `Dispatch: INFRA-583`, dispatch:// links only (check-private-names refuses the dashboard host). This PR's run runs all five (workflow file changed). Scratch PR A (base legion/INFRA-583): comment in a packages/contracts/src/*.ts file and a trailing blank line in skills/dispatch/SKILL.md -> five check runs conclusion skipped. Scratch PR B (base legion/INFRA-583): comment in a packages/envoy/internal/pgmigrate/*.go file (in all five closures) -> five start. Read via gh api commits/<sha>/check-runs. Close both and delete their branches after recording run URLs.

6. AC3: throwaway script over the INFRA-490 window (2026-10-23T21:05Z..10-26T20:34Z): PR runs of this workflow, jobs, PR files; billed minutes per measurement method; before = five jobs' minutes, after = only runs whose PR files match the new filter; per job, total, and minutes per PR push; plus one real non-Go-only PR run vs scratch PR A.
7. PR body per skill://legion-worker/references/pr-body.md with proofs, measurement table, the two departures, E2E lines.

findings.finding: Router PR #2316 (INFRA-520) already defines per-job filters for these five jobs.
findings.answer: The plan copies #2316's five filters and their anchors, changing only the workflow file name and dropping the four memory-profile guides; reported to the architect.

findings.finding: cmd/broker/main_test.go:220 passes packages/envoy/docker/rds-global-bundle.pem; not covered by internal/** plus cmd/broker.
internal/** plus exact cmd dirs is not drift-proof: #2229 adds packages/envoy/listenfd imported by internal/cmdtest, cmd/dispatch, cmd/listener.
findings.answer: Exact package lists (as #2316); Task 1 adds listenfd (or any new closure member on main) before the final push; envoy-go keeps the broad gate and runs every untagged unit test; guides name each filter.

findings.finding: #2167 adds a race step over cmd/listener that reads packages/contracts/fixtures/dispatch-targeted-delivery.json.
findings.answer: envoy_go_race already names packages/envoy/**; Task 1 adds the fixture if #2167 is on main first; reported to the architect for #2167's rebase otherwise.

findings.finding: The four guides memory_profile_test.go:147-148 reads are behind t.Skip unless DISPATCH_EDIT_PROFILE_OUT is set; CI never reads them, and two of them are outside on.paths.
findings.answer: No filter names them; #2316's error reported to the architect.

findings.finding: Memory and multiprocess closures differ (apitest vs testnats).
findings.answer: dispatch_multiprocess adds internal/testnats/*; apitest is under internal/dispatch/**.

findings.finding: Spec AC1 contradicts the code for envoy-go-race (Bun, proof-editor, fixtures).
findings.answer: Two recorded spec departures: five per-job filters, and envoy-go-race keeps starting on proof-editor, Bun install inputs and two fixture dirs.

findings.finding: A frozen Bun install reads every workspace manifest, not only package.json and bun.lock.
findings.answer: envoy_go_race uses bun_install (every workspace manifest, patches, Bun pin and installer), as #2316; existing filters are out of scope and keep their convention.

findings.finding: Whether the workflow file belongs in the five filters.
findings.answer: Yes: a step change must run its job, and this PR's own run then proves all five at the head; cost stated.

findings.finding: AC2 needs scratch PRs based on the issue branch, checked by check-run conclusion.
findings.answer: Task 5: both scratch PRs on base legion/INFRA-583; skipped vs not-skipped via the check-runs API; pgmigrate is in all five closures.

findings.answer: Task 6 names the window, API calls, billing rules, metric (per job, total, per PR push) and an [INFERENCE] range; PR text uses dispatch:// links.

findings.answer: Whichever merges second resolves; textual conflicts per conflicts-and-rewrites.md; reported to the architect.

specDepartures.spec: AC1: a new filter for the four Go-only jobs (dispatch-memory, dispatch-multiprocess, broker-multiprocess, envoy-go-race) and one for envoy-infra-go.
specDepartures.plan: One filter per job (five), built from shared YAML anchors, identical to router PR #2316's per-job filters.
specDepartures.evidence: envoy-go-race is not Go-only: envoy-and-contracts.yaml:977-978 install Bun, and pmdoc's update_test.go:236-239 runs Bun scripts that import @legion/proof-editor; its tests also read packages/contracts/fixtures/{delivery-live,decision-blocks} and every .go/.md under packages/envoy. A union filter for the four would start dispatch-memory on those, which AC1 itself forbids. The file's rule is one filter per job (line 146).

acceptance: AC1: 'a new filter for the four Go-only jobs … and one for envoy-infra-go' becomes 'one filter per job for the five jobs'

TypeScript contracts (packages/contracts/src) and skill files start none of the five, so AC2 is unchanged.
